ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's intimidation/detention allegation; do not auto-adjudicate any fare item. Contact rider per RydeHELP, preserve chat log (F3/F4), obtain driver's full account, and advise rider of 995 / driver commercial insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths if she felt unsafe. Consider account review under the code of conduct pending outcome.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen first. The complaint is a threat/intimidation allegation ("threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out… felt unsafe for the whole ride"), and the rider's own in-trip message [F3] asks to stop and be let out while the driver's reply [F4] is "Sit down or I lock the doors." Read in context this is not a pickup arrangement but a conditional threat of confinement aimed at the rider, i.e. abuse/intimidation under Ryde's code of conduct → SAFE-1. The driver's own statement [F6] confirms he refused the stop request and "drove on"; the ride continued to Bedok Mall with drop-off at 17:31. Per SAFE-1 I do not rule on the merits; the case is escalated for a human reviewer with the factual summary. Separately, the dispute type is "safety", which under SAFE-2 (dangerous-driving/injury allegations) also removes auto-adjudication. No clause-based fare outcome is computed: route distance was at or below optimal (15.4 km vs 15.5 km, -0.1 km [F1]) and duration only +1.9 min [F2], so there is no route-deviation refund to award, and the alleged refusal-to-stop/detention event is not a fare item covered by RD/NS/FARE but a conduct matter. Profiles [F7][F8] show no prior disputes either side and per the rules cannot decide this case. Chat record is complete and timestamped [F5], so the record settles what was said; the escalation is driven by the safety classification, not by missing evidence.
ruling.escalation_reason: Threat/intimidation allegation by rider (SAFE-1) and dispute type = safety (SAFE-2) — no automatic adjudication; human reviewer to assess driver conduct (refusal to stop, alleged threat to lock doors) and rider's safety concern, with 995 / driver commercial insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths noted.

rejected_claims.reason: GPS shows actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km (-0.1 km, [F1]); no off-route segment exists, so no RD-1/RD-2 refund arises.
No disputed fare item is established on the record (no deviation, duration +1.9 min [F2]); the underlying grievance is conduct, not charging, so it is routed to human review instead of a fare ruling.
